newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia puts 39 rebel Serbs on trial.
newsitem.headline: Croatia puts 39 rebel Serbs on trial.

text.p: Croatia put 39 former Serb soldiers on trial on Monday accused of committing war crimes during the minority Serb uprising against Croatian independence from Yugoslavia, the state news agency HINA said.
Twelve men will appear before a court in the Dalmatian port of Split while 27 others are still at large and will be tried in absentia, HINA said.
They have been indicted for war crimes against civilians and for attempts to blow up the Peruca dam, which would have devastated a large area in southern Croatia.
Croatia regained most of the territory captured by rebel Serbs in two blitz offensives in 1995. It later passed a general amnesty law, except for those it says have committed war crimes.
